topics.title: Citizenship
topics.description: Haqooq aur farz — ghar, school, Islamabad mein achha citizen
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Sadi, socho: school mein line mein khade ho, park mein kaghaz na phenko, chhote dost ki madad karo — yeh bhi citizenship hai!

## SAMJHAO
Citizen community ka hissa hai. Uske haqooq (rights) aur farz (duties) dono hote hain.

## MISAAL
Margalla pe litter na phenkna; canteen queue; assembly mein ehteram.

## KARO
3 cheezein likho: ghar farz, school haq, mohalla madad.

## SAWAAL
1. Haq aur farz mein farq?
2. Bacche citizen kaise?
3. School ka ek community rule?

questions.q: Citizen ke paas kya hota hai?
Bacche citizenship kab practise karte hain?

topics.title: Culture
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Pakistan mein kitni zubanen aur tehwaren hain!

## SAMJHAO
Culture = riwaj, khana, libas, zuban, festivals.

## MISAAL
Eid, Independence Day, local melas.

## KARO
Apne ghar ki ek riwayat likho.

## SAWAAL
1. Culture kya hai?
2. Ek Pakistani festival?

topics.title: State aur Government
topics.description: Pakistan ka nizam — rules kaun banata hai
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
School rules ki tarah mulk ka nizam bhi hota hai.

## SAMJHAO
Government rules aur services (school, roads, safety) manage karti hai.

## MISAAL
Traffic lights, public schools.

## KARO
Ek government service likho.

## SAWAAL
1. Government kyun zaroori?
2. Ek public service?

topics.title: History
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Purani kahaniyan aaj ki samajh banati hain.

## SAMJHAO
History past events se seekhna hai.

## MISAAL
Pakistan se mutaliq simple age-appropriate stories.

## KARO
Ek hero/event ka naam likho.

## SAWAAL
1. History kyun parhte hain?
2. Ek example?

topics.title: Geography
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Map pe apna shehar dhoondo!

## SAMJHAO
Geography zameen, mountains, cities, maps.

## MISAAL
Islamabad, Margalla Hills.

## KARO
Map pe apna shehar mark karo.

## SAWAAL
1. Map kis kaam?
2. Margalla kahan?

topics.title: Economics
topics.description: Needs, wants, simple money aur kaam
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Ice cream vs kitaab — pehle kya?

## SAMJHAO
Needs zaroori; wants extra. Paise/kaam se cheezein milti hain.

## MISAAL
Saving karke kitaab.

## KARO
3 needs aur 3 wants likho.

## SAWAAL
1. Need vs want?
2. Saving kyun?
